paragraphs.text: The Official Classic Sixth Edition Game Strategy Guide is a guide to the cards in the Classic Sixth Edition Magic: The Gathering core set . It is a softcover paperback with 128 pages, was written by Randy Buehler , contributor to The Duelist at the time. It was published by Wizards of the Coast in May 1999.

Gain the upper hand with the strategy guide to Magic: The Gathering Classic card set. Randy Buehler, columnist for The Duelist magazine, and veteran tournament player , draws on his professional experience to help players master the new Classic rules. • Randy Buehler is a former Pro Tour Rookie Player of the Year . • The guide includes deckbuilding tips, playing strategy, and deck themes.
